# Bayana Global Limited

> ADGM-registered corporate services firm at 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Phone/WhatsApp +971 50 107 4414. Office hours Mon–Thu 8:00–17:00, Fri 8:00–11:30 (Gulf Standard Time).

Bayana Global Limited supports companies, entrepreneurs and investors in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) across financial, non-financial and retail activities: company incorporation, licensing, DED-to-ADGM licence conversion (500+ conversions and related cases), establishment card, visas and work permits, office space and AccessRP lease upgrades, licence renewal and annual filings, company closure, ADGM Courts notary assistance, non-Muslim will registration, legal translation and attestation, and AML/DNFBP compliance coordination through partners. Office space is arranged through its sister company Aegis Coworking Business Center (https://aegiscoworking.ae) at Addax Tower.

Key facts:
- Foreign investors can own 100% of an ADGM company, subject to applicable requirements.
- ADGM companies on Al Reem Island and Al Maryah Island need a suitable registered office arrangement (desk or office); the visa quota depends on that arrangement.
- For FSRA-regulated financial businesses, Bayana handles the corporate setup; the FSRA application is handled by the client's regulatory adviser.
- Bayana coordinates notarisation and will registration; notarisation is performed by the ADGM Courts Notary Public and Bayana does not give legal advice.
- Government, ADGM and court fees are separate from Bayana's professional fees.

## Company Setup
- [ADGM Company Formation](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-company-formation): Structure advice, name reservation, documents, KYC and Registration Authority filing.
- [Financial Sector Setup](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-financial-services-company-setup): Corporate setup for asset managers, advisers and brokers, alongside your FSRA consultant.
- [Non-Financial Setup](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-non-financial-company-setup): Consultancy, technology, holding, trading and professional services companies.
- [Retail Licence](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-retail-licence): Licences for shops, restaurants, cafés and salons on Al Reem Island.
- [DED to ADGM Conversion](https://www.bayana.ae/ded-to-adgm-licence-conversion): 500+ conversions handled for Al Reem Island businesses.
- [SPV Setup](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-spv-setup): Special purpose vehicles to hold shares, property or investments.
- [Foundation Setup](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-foundation-setup): Foundations for asset protection and family succession.

## Corporate Services
- [CSP & Registered Office](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-csp-registered-office): Registered office, registered agent and statutory filings.
- [Filings & Licence Renewal](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-annual-filings-licence-renewal): Renewal, confirmation statement, accounts, data protection and amendments.
- [Company Closure](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-company-closure): Visa cancellations, final filings, licence cancellation and strike-off.
- [AML & DNFBP Compliance](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-aml-dnfbp-compliance): MLRO, AML/KYC policies and goAML registration through partners.

## Visa & Office
- [Visa & Work Permits](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-visa-work-permit): Establishment card, director, employee and dependent visas, work permits.
- [Office Space & Lease Upgrade](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-office-space-lease): Desks and offices at Addax Tower, AccessRP registration and visa-quota upgrades.

## Legal & Documents
- [Notary Services](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-courts-notary): Powers of attorney, resolutions and declarations at ADGM Courts.
- [Non-Muslim Wills](https://www.bayana.ae/adgm-non-muslim-will-registration): Register a will covering UAE assets and guardianship at ADGM Courts.
- [Translation & Attestation](https://www.bayana.ae/legal-translation-attestation-abu-dhabi): Certified translation, MOFA legalisation and ADGM certificates.
